body: Roam Control 0.9.9 (Build 105) — originally released 20 Oct 2026, restored for independent sideloading 25 Nov 2026 after Apple disabled App Store/TestFlight availability. Choose, test and move an iPhone's reported location. Requires iOS 27 or newer and Developer Mode; LocalDevVPN required for local pairing. Unsigned IPA — sign with SideStore or another method; in LiveContainer enable Fix Local Notifications before first launch.
